chat.emptyBody: What you write stays on your computer.
chat.emptyBodyNetwork: Nothing is sent on the network, let alone on the Internet.
chat.timedOut: Answer incomplete: the AI stopped writing.
chat.notIndexedYet: Please analyze your documents before asking a question.
chat.unanalysed: {documents} in the folder: this answer does not rest on them. Run the analysis to include them.
chat.scopeOutdated: Of the files you chose for this conversation, {files} could not be used (missing or changed since). This answer does not rest on them.
chat.scopeNoneWarning: No document is used: answers do not rest on your documents. Open the list to choose some.
chat.scopeWholeWarning: Every analysed document is used. Open the list to choose the ones this conversation is about.
chat.modelAttempted: {model} was asked, and took {duration}, but could not turn this question into something the engine could compute.
chat.deterministic: Answered from your documents folder, without the AI.
chat.needsFolder: Choose a documents folder first, in the panel on the left.
chat.disclaimer: Administrative assistance. Always check the answer: the practitioner remains the sole decision maker.
chat.clearBody: Every question and answer on screen will be forgotten. Your documents and their analysis are not affected.
chat.deterministicData: Answer computed from your data folder, without the AI.
chat.documentsNotNeeded: Answered from your tables; the selected documents were not needed.

workFolder.title: Documents folder
workFolder.descriptionFull: The folder for text: PDF, DOCX, even JPEG... Choose a dedicated folder, not the whole of your documents, and not a folder copied to a cloud service.
workFolder.suggestionWhy: It sits outside your Documents on purpose, so that nothing is copied to OneDrive or iCloud.
workFolder.ocrEngineUnavailable: Text recognition did not start: scanned documents are reported unreadable while it is missing.
workFolder.pageRasterizerUnavailable: Scanned-PDF reading did not start: JPEG and PNG images are still read, scanned PDFs are not.
workFolder.removedOne: document removed from the folder, forgotten by the analysis
workFolder.removedMany: documents removed from the folder, forgotten by the analysis
workFolder.renamedOne: file renamed to remove spaces and accents
workFolder.renamedMany: files renamed to remove spaces and accents
workFolder.renameFailedOne: file could not be renamed (is it open in another program?) and was kept as it is
workFolder.renameFailedMany: files could not be renamed (are they open in another program?) and were kept as they are
workFolder.revealHint: Open this folder in the file manager
workFolder.revealFileHint: Show this file in the file manager
workFolder.resetBody: Everything that has been analysed will be forgotten, and the analysis has to be run again before these documents can be asked about. Your files are neither moved nor deleted: they stay exactly where they are in the folder.

dataFolder.title: Data folder
dataFolder.descriptionFull: The folder for spreadsheets: CSV, XLSX. Choose a dedicated folder, never one copied to an online service. Spreadsheets are read on this computer, without the AI.
dataFolder.suggestionWhy: It sits beside your documents folder, outside your Documents, so that nothing is copied to OneDrive or iCloud.
dataFolder.revealHint: Open this folder in the file manager
dataFolder.resetBody: Everything read from your spreadsheets will be forgotten, and the analysis will have to run again before asking about this data. Your files are neither moved nor deleted, and the analysis of your documents is not affected.
dataFolder.passDone: {count} on this computer, without the AI: spreadsheets are analysed in a moment.
dataFolder.removedOne: spreadsheet removed from the folder, forgotten by the analysis
dataFolder.removedMany: spreadsheets removed from the folder, forgotten by the analysis
dataFolder.scopeNoneWarning: No data is used: answers rely on none of your spreadsheets. Open the list to choose some.
dataFolder.scopeWholeWarning: Every readable spreadsheet is used. Open the list to choose the ones this conversation is about.

folderAnswer.extensionTotal: Your documents folder holds {count} with the extension {extension}.
folderAnswer.noSubfolder: Your documents folder has no subfolder.
folderAnswer.ambiguous: Several files are named {query}. Which one do you mean?
folderAnswer.noMatch: No file named {query} is in your documents folder.
folderAnswer.fileUnreadable: Nothing could be read from {name}, so there is nothing to quote from it.
folderAnswer.notSelected: {query} is in your documents folder but is not selected for this conversation. Tick it in the documents list to use it.
folderAnswer.nothingSelected: No document is selected for this conversation.

kind.tabular_candidate: spreadsheet, belongs in the data folder

extraction.native_text: text taken from the file itself

settings.title: Settings
settings.resetDescription: Puts every setting back to how it started, including the choice of documents folder.
settings.resetBody: The theme, the language, the AI address, the models, the idle timeout and the choice of documents folder will all go back to how they started. Your documents and their analysis are not deleted: choosing the same folder again finds them exactly as they were.
settings.languageDescription: The interface, the messages and the language the answers are written in.
settings.serverUrlDescription: The practice AI. Never a public service.
settings.modelAliasDescription: Which profile answers. The list comes from the AI.
settings.modelAliasUnavailable: The AI has not listed its profiles yet.
settings.idleTimeoutDescription: How long to wait when the AI goes quiet, in seconds. A long answer is never cut off while it is still being written; this only ends the wait when nothing arrives at all. Raise it on a slower computer or with a larger model.

errors.batch_too_large: Too many passages were sent at once ({count} for a limit of {limit}). The folder is indexed in smaller batches.
errors.chat_cancelled: The question was stopped before any answer.
errors.context_too_large: This question is too long for one request ({chars} characters for a limit of {limit}). Shorten it.
errors.extraction_empty: This file has no readable text ({path}).
errors.extraction_failed: This file could not be read ({path}).
errors.index_unavailable: The local index could not be opened. Try again; if it persists, restart the application.
errors.insufficient_evidence: No information in your documents answers this question.
errors.scope_unavailable: The documents you chose for this conversation are missing or have changed. Choose them again.
errors.internal_error: The AI ran into an unexpected problem. Try again; if it persists, note the time and report it.
errors.no_work_folder_set: Choose a documents folder before asking a question about your documents.
errors.no_data_folder_set: Choose a data folder first, in the left-hand panel.
errors.data_folder_no_longer_allowed: Your data folder no longer meets the safety rules, most often because a cloud service now copies it. Choose it again.
errors.invalid_request: The AI refused the request because it was malformed. Please report it.
errors.model_alias_not_allowed: The profile {requested} is not offered by this AI. Choose another one in the settings.
errors.ocr_failed: This page could not be read by recognition ({path}, page {page}).
errors.ocr_language_unavailable: Text recognition does not support the language {locale} yet.
errors.ocr_page_unreadable: This page has no text recognition could keep.
errors.ocr_unavailable: Text recognition is not available. Scanned pages are reported as unreadable until it is fixed.
errors.output_locale_not_supported: This software cannot yet answer in the language {requested}.
errors.provider_capability_unsupported: The AI cannot do this yet ({capability}).
errors.provider_error: The model did not answer correctly. Try again.
errors.provider_unreachable: The AI is running but its model is not answering. Warn whoever looks after the machine.
errors.server_error: The AI replied with an error (code {status}).
errors.server_response_invalid: The AI reply could not be read.
errors.server_timeout: The AI stopped answering and nothing more arrived. Whatever it had written is kept above. Try again, or raise the waiting time in the settings.
errors.server_unreachable: No answer from the AI at {url}. Check that the machine is on and on the same network.
errors.server_url_invalid: This AI address cannot be used ({url}). It must start with http:// or https://.
errors.settings_read_failed: Your settings could not be read, so the default ones are in use.
errors.settings_write_failed: Your settings could not be saved.
errors.work_folder_is_cloud_synced: This folder is copied to {service} ({path}). Professional documents must not leave the practice, so choose a folder outside it, for example directly in your user folder.
errors.work_folder_is_drive_root: A whole disk cannot be the documents folder ({path}). Choose a folder inside it.
errors.work_folder_is_protected: This folder is protected, or it holds all of your personal files ({path}). Choose a dedicated subfolder.
errors.work_folder_no_longer_allowed: Your documents folder no longer meets the safety rules, most often because a cloud service now copies it. Choose it again.
errors.work_folder_is_symlink: This folder is a shortcut to somewhere else ({path}). Choose the real folder.
errors.work_folder_not_a_directory: This is a file, not a folder ({path}).
errors.work_folder_not_writable: This software cannot write into this folder ({path}).
errors.work_folder_reveal_failed: The file manager could not be opened. Nothing in the folder was changed.
errors.work_folder_unc_not_supported: A network folder cannot be the documents folder yet ({path}).
errors.documents_and_tables_together: Documents and data are both selected. A question that is only about your data is now answered from your tables; combining both in one answer is coming later. Until then, untick one of the two lists for any other question.

nudge.not_recognised: I cannot answer that question directly for {file}.
nudge.sheet_not_found: That sheet does not exist in {file}.
nudge.ambiguous_sheet_name: {file} has several sheets: name the one you mean in the question.
nudge.column_not_found: That column does not exist in {file}.
nudge.ambiguous_column_name: Several columns of {file} match: name the one you mean.
nudge.row_out_of_range: That row does not exist in {file}.
nudge.non_numeric_column: That column of {file} does not hold numbers only: it can be neither added up nor compared.
nudge.formula_cannot_be_verified: That column of {file} holds formulas: their results cannot be verified, so nothing is computed from them.
nudge.empty_sheet: There is no data to compute in {file}.
nudge.filter_not_supported: Your question names a filter (“{value}”) that this engine cannot apply yet, so nothing is computed unfiltered from {file}.
nudge.non_date_column: That filter names a day, month, year or date range, but that column of {file} is not a recognised date column.
nudge.value_not_found: “{value}” does not match any real value in {file}.

tabularAnswer.nudgeFilterColumn: That word was found in the {column} column.
tabularAnswer.nudgeOperations: Try asking for a sum, a minimum, a maximum, a number of rows, the list of a column's values, or the group with the largest total.
tabularAnswer.nudgeAgain: Your previous question could not be computed either: name one of the columns above exactly.
tabularAnswer.unreadable: {file} could not be read as a table: it holds no usable sheet, so nothing is computed from it.
tabularAnswer.notAnalysed: {file} has not been analysed yet. Run the data folder analysis, then ask again.
tabularAnswer.whichWorkbook: Several spreadsheets are selected. Which one do you mean? Name it in the question:
tabularAnswer.ambiguous: Several spreadsheets match {query}. Which one do you mean?
tabularAnswer.notSelected: {query} is in your data folder but is not selected for this conversation. Tick it in the data list to use it.
tabularAnswer.noMatch: No file named {query} is in your data folder.
tabularAnswer.noUsableTable: No spreadsheet in your data folder holds a usable table. Run the analysis, or add a CSV or XLSX file.
tabularAnswer.largestGroupTie: Tie for the largest total {column} by {group}: **{leaders}**, with **{value}** each.
tabularAnswer.groupRanking: The leaders, out of {groups} in all:
tabularAnswer.groupTotalNote: This is the total per {group}, added up over every row, not the largest single row.
tabularAnswer.whichMeasure: To rank by {group}, several columns in {file} could be added up: {columns}. Name the one you mean, for example “Which {group} has the highest total {first}?”
tabularAnswer.unparsedOne: cell could not be read as a number
tabularAnswer.unparsedMany: cells could not be read as numbers
tabularAnswer.whichColumn: “{value}” exists in several possible columns: {columns}. Name the one you mean, for example {first}.
tabularAnswer.interpretedRephrase: The question itself was understood by the model before the engine computed this value. If that is not what you meant, rephrase your question.
tabularAnswer.leastGroupTie: Tie for the smallest total {column} by {group}: **{leaders}**, with **{value}** each.
tabularAnswer.groupTotalNoteLeast: This is the total per {group}, added up over every row, not the single smallest row.
tabularAnswer.topGroupsCapped: The requested top {requested} was capped at 50.
